exposure: Indian-born mothers compared to other mothers in Australia
outcome: Low to very low birth weight
cohort: All births in Australia in 2012 and births in the Monash Health Birthing Outcomes System (BOS) 2014
finding: Indian-born mothers in Australia have an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, including induced labor, emergency cesarean section, preterm birth, low birth weight, and low Apgar scores, despite having access to high quality maternity care and some protective factors.
gest_age: Specifically mentions very preterm birth (20-27 weeks)
birth_weight: Specifically mentions low to very low birth weight
